# Claude AI Chat

> > Comprehensive resource for Claude AI by Anthropic, covering models, API integration, coding tools, and implementation guides.

Claude AI Chat (c-ai.chat) provides documentation, tutorials, and comparisons for Anthropic's Claude models including Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku variants. The site focuses on developer tools, API integration, prompt engineering, and practical use cases for Claude's Constitutional AI technology.

## Key Topics

- Anthropic
- Claude AI models (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku)
- Claude API
- Constitutional AI
- Claude Code (AI coding assistant)
- Context window (100K-200K tokens)
- Multimodal AI capabilities
- Prompt engineering & adaptive prompting
- Developer tools & workflows
- Desktop app (Windows, Mac, macOS)
- Document analysis
- API integration
- Model comparison
- Conversational AI
- Extended thinking mode

## Claude Models

- [Models Overview](https://c-ai.chat/models): Compare all Claude models: Opus, Sonnet, Haiku variants by Anthropic
- [Claude Sonnet 4](https://c-ai.chat/models/claude-sonnet-4): Latest Claude Sonnet 4 model with advanced reasoning & extended thinking
- [Claude Opus 4.5](https://c-ai.chat/models/claude-opus-4-5): Anthropic's most advanced Claude Opus 4.5 model for complex reasoning
- [Claude 3 Sonnet](https://c-ai.chat/models/claude-3-sonnet): Anthropic's Claude 3 Sonnet model for coding & technical tasks
- [Claude Haiku 4.5](https://c-ai.chat/models/claude-haiku-4-5): Fast, lightweight Claude Haiku 4.5 for quick everyday tasks
